import numpy as np


def most_similar(ratings, user):
    me = np.array(ratings[user], dtype=float)

    def sim(other):
        v = np.array(ratings[other], dtype=float)
        return me @ v / (np.linalg.norm(me) * np.linalg.norm(v))

    others = [u for u in ratings if u != user]
    return sorted(others, key=lambda u: (-round(sim(u), 10), u))
